entry_points.text: Poll input reports NO_POLL_CHAR when receive-empty else data byte; poll output waits for transmit space with relaxation then writes byte; console output waits for space, writes byte and tracks line end; option probe decodes parity, seven versus eight bits, divisor and baud, doubling when oversampling factor set.

Type returns driver string for AMBA else null; config assigns AMBA type; verify rejects type/IRQ/base/mapbase mismatch; match accepts two names over memory widths binding mapbase; probe negotiates slot/resources/layout/FIFO/width/operations/timers; SBSA uses firmware baud with fallback and fixed FIFO/baud.

Initialization registers platform driver before AMBA driver with warning on platform failure, exit reverses; module lifecycle verifies feature storage views align then registers bus and creates debug, exit removes debug, unregisters bus and destroys index allocator.

exports.text: Standard table wires empty, modem, tx/rx controls, throttle, break, startup/shutdown, termios, type/config/verify and poll hooks; SBSA reuses tx/rx/type/config/verify/poll but uses no-op modem set, zero modem get and SBSA startup/shutdown/termios.

Core exposes read-only device, vendor, status, modalias and feature bitstring attributes in null-terminated table via container helper, plus small helpers to clear, init from one word, compare and copy feature sets over fixed word count.

Registration binds bus, allocs index/name, inits locks/queues, resets then acks, creates debug before adding; teardown removes debug, unregisters, frees index; driver registration validates feature table then registers.

Lifecycle covers shutdown without driver callback, freeze with failure preservation, restore via shared helper, reset prepare/done with optional hooks; debug provides top root plus per-device feature and filter files with recursive removal.

hazards.text: Quiescing may observe fresh interrupt immediately after clearing, treated benign; polling output and console emission spin with relaxation until transmit space or busy clears, with no timeout relying on hardware progress.
Requesting confirmation for feature bit absent from both standard and legacy driver tables terminates execution.

invariants.text: Quiesce acks pending sources seen in masked status via clear register, then masks transmit-ready enable leaving others; transmit-ready cannot be cleared, only masked, with transmit start expected to unmask later.

Read/ignore masks derive from termios input/control; baud uses divisor 8 oversampled else 16 with clock rounding and variant high-speed tweaks; frame maps size/stop/parity/FIFO; modem watch on PPS/flow/non-local; SBSA forces fixed baud 8N1 local no flow.

Early transmit polls space, writes width-appropriate character, polls completion, with quirk using fixed wide accessor; setup rejects unmapped port, installs output and possible input hooks, full device preserves modem while enabling controller/receiver/transmitter.

Match scans identifier table with ANY wildcards and exports modalias on hotplug; handshake intersects device/driver caps with version handling, requires modern plus access when constrained, asserts accepted; helpers prefer extended else legacy word; device tree expects single available child with prefix plus hex identifier.

Host page numbers scale by pages per host unit; grow and shrink cap to one array, collect outside then enqueue/dequeue under lock updating counts, notify only when produced and before dropping references; exchange builds one scatter over valid prefix, kicks and waits for acknowledgement.

locks.text: Enabling uses interrupt-saving lock, clears spurious timeout/receive pendings, drains FIFO then programs timeout plus conditional receive; disabling zeroes saved mask then clears all pendings; console device lock applies interrupt-saving discipline on indexed port entry.

Configuration gating updates enabled flag and flushes pending change notification while holding device configuration lock with interrupts masked; balloon object carries stop-update, free-list and wakeup locks plus size mutex.

state_machines.text: Init selects pins, enables clock, clears pendings/errors, saves mask, enables receive/timeout; startup chains init/interrupt/triggers, enables UART/receive/transmit preserving modem, snapshots modem, starts DMA, enables interrupts, SBSA omitting triggers/control/modem/DMA; split writes receive, delays, then transmit; shutdown disables interrupts, stops DMA, frees interrupt, cancels timers, stops RS485, disables UART/clock/pins, runs exit and flushes, SBSA only interrupts/free/flush.

Setup clamps index, looks up port, selects pins, enables clock, samples rate, uses fixed or parsed/probed baud/parity/bits; exit disables clock; atomic enters unsafe region, temporarily enables UART/transmit, emits newline when needed, writes buffer, spins for idle, restores; threaded cycles unsafe exit/entry per byte with re-acquire loop.

Lifecycle finds empty slot, maps registers, resolves firmware alias, populates state and publishes; registration masks and clears interrupts, registers driver once, adds port with rollback on failure; unregistration clears entry, removes DMA state and unregisters driver when idle.

Probe marks driver presence, intersects and finalizes features with validation, completes handshake, invokes driver probe, ensures ready, runs scan and enables notifications, marking failure on error; removal disables configuration, invokes driver removal then re-acknowledges; restore resets, acknowledges, finalizes, validates and readies; shutdown dispatches driver hook when present else generic reset sequence.

structs.text: Global indexed port table sized by UART count; console descriptor links UART driver, unassigned index, printbuffer plus anytime plus nonblocking, AMA name and setup/teardown/match/write/lock handlers; driver record gives major/minor/count/console linkage and RS485 caps with unit delays.

Balloon groups transport, queues, workqueues, gating, configuration, free-list, command and acknowledgement waiting, counts, staging and statistics arrays, shrinker, out-of-memory and reporting state; bus carries name with match, groups, hotplug, probe, remove, affinity, shutdown and virtual-function handlers; device table matches balloon identifier with terminator.

Port uses PORT_AMBA; consoles pl011 and qdf2400_e44 over MEM and MEM32; SBSA matches OF arm,sbsa-uart and ACPI ARMH0011 plus ARMHB000 with driver sbsa-uart; PL011 AMBA matches ARM, ST, NVIDIA and ZTE identifiers with driver uart-pl011 and names ttyAMA; balloon staging array holds 256 entries.
